'''Velmor''' was the third, terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Velm system]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] near [[Myrkr/Legends|Myrkr]], [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]] and [[Aquaris/Legends|Aquaris]].

Its diameter was 11,788 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]], and its [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] was slightly below standard, at 0.92. A Velmorian [[Standard day/Legends|day]] was 26 standard [[Time/Legends|hours]], and its [[Standard year/Legends|year]] 297 [[Local day/Legends|local days]].

Velmor was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to two [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]: native [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Velmoc]] and [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]]-speaking [[Human/Legends|Human]] colonists known as [[Velmorian]]s, although the former were nearly extinct by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], making up a scant third of a percent of the population.

==History==
Human colonists from the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Empress Teta system]] arrived on Velmor around [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], settling amongst its calm [[Grass/Legends|grasslands]]. Despite its proximity to Obroa-skai, Velmor went relatively untouched after its colonization, falling into deep isolation. As a result, the Velmorians became dependent on imports of technology. A benevolent [[Monarchy/Legends|monarchy]], reminiscent of the [[Empress Teta/Legends|Tetan]] model, was established and ruled the world from the planetary capital of [[Den Velmor]]. The Velmorian society that developed placed a high value on the fine arts, exporting much of their artwork and literature to far-off worlds. The Velmorian economy was buoyed by exports of [[Velmstone/Legends|velmstone]], local foodstuffs, and precious stone and metals. As the colonists expanded to establish small villages and farms away from Den Velmor, the Velmoc retreated to the [[Tol Velmoc mountains]].

When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] learned in [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]] that [[King/Legends|King]] [[Lorac]] supported the ideals of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], a plot was hatched between the Lord Regent, [[Zelor]], and the [[Imperial Diplomatic Corps/Legends|Imperial Diplomatic Corps]] to place a prince friendly to the Empire on the throne. A mob was paid to assault and kill the king and [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Denira]], sparing the Imperial-influenced [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Anod]]. But [[Denid]], the crown-prince, and his [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] bride escaped offworld to [[Tantajoc V]] with the aid of Denid's Velmoc servant, [[Jedidiah]]. A Velmorian tradition of waiting twenty years before declaring a missing prince dead allowed Zelor to rule Velmor until 3 ABY. It was then, the Diplomatic Corps believed, that Anod would be crowned king and&mdash;with the manipulation of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Zeta Traal]], the Imperial diplomat assigned to Velmor&mdash;the world would fall into line with the Empire.

After the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction of Alderaan]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], many Alderaanian survivors made Velmor their new home, in part due to its similar society and ecology. It was during this time that both the Rebel Alliance and the Empire became aware of the strategic value of the wealth and resources of Velmor. According to the report of Zeta Traal, the planet's forest would have been used as game hunting grounds for wealthy tourists while the ore and gem mines were exploited.<ref name="wizards" />

Around that time, Denid was discovered by the Rebel Alliance and escorted back to Velmor by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]. There, with the aid of those loyal to Denid, they defeated Traal and Zelor. Denid was then crowned King of Velmor, and formally aligned the planet with the Rebel Alliance.
